scope: Corrected-physics fit-quality diagnostics; timings not a benchmark

checks.detail: QARR 1g pattern spans the published 5-150 degree grid.
The documented 1e-4 CIF coordinate tolerance gives physical unit-cell contents.
checks.criterion: expanded site counts Al2O3=30, ZnO=4, CaF2=12

checks.detail: Refinement returns a finite last accepted state under explicit iteration budgets.
checks.criterion: no numerical failure, divergence, repeated rejection, or empty data

checks.detail: Poisson-weighted QARR profile gate with fixed CIF anisotropic displacement.
Unit-weight profile residual is reported separately from Poisson-weighted Rwp.
Background-subtracted observed and calculated profiles remain strongly aligned.
Hill--Howard weight fractions agree with the independently weighed phase fractions.
The final scale covariance propagates analytically to finite phase-fraction uncertainties.
checks.criterion: finite nonnegative propagated variance for every phase fraction

notes: Calculated crystalline weight fractions: Al2O3=30.848%, ZnO=34.019%, CaF2=35.133%.
Maximum propagated phase-fraction standard uncertainty=0.00085938.
Stage 1 termination=max_iterations, iterations=7, evaluations=31, Rwp=0.26390649.
Stage 2 termination=max_iterations, iterations=28, evaluations=29, Rwp=0.19885850.
Stage 3 scale polish termination=converged, iterations=1, evaluations=2, Poisson Rwp=0.19885480, unit-weight Rwp=0.13328237, Rp=0.15638249.
Expanded sites at tolerance 1e-4: {'Al2O3': 30, 'ZnO': 4, 'CaF2': 12}.
CIF anisotropic displacement tensors are evaluated directly and remain fixed.
Sites without CIF displacement values start from Uiso=0.005 Å² and are refined.
Fixed Cu K-alpha1 Cromer--Liberman offsets are used for both doublet components; component-dependent dispersion is not interpolated.

Extended budgets are 64/224 accepted-iteration limits for stages one/two; other guards unchanged.
Free-background cases retain the bounded first stage, then allow 224 iterations with three extra background parameters.
Seed cases replace the start of stage two with rietx stage-one scales, background, widths and zero.
Seed instrument U is set to zero and the same negative U is added to each sample Gaussian strain coefficient, preserving total Gaussian widths.
Seed cases retain PhaseSmith stage-two and polish budgets. Their recorded first-stage result is the original unused PhaseSmith stage-one fit.
Width calls include compilation and prediction, so each reflection line is recorded twice; do not sum them as unique rows.
No production defaults or scientific acceptance criteria were changed. Inspect status and termination for each diagnostic.
